# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the problem, the change, and any intentionally excluded scope.

## Validation

List the exact commands you ran and their results.

## Impact assessment

- [ ] Deterministic behavior and replay compatibility are unchanged, or the change is documented with regression coverage.
- [ ] Benchmark impact was measured or is not applicable.
- [ ] Scenario, fixture, export, or schema compatibility impact is documented.
- [ ] Synthetic-only data rules are preserved. No credentials, production data, personal data, or generated secrets are included.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` were updated when user-visible behavior changed.
- [ ] Generated outputs and local build artifacts are not included unintentionally.

## Reviewer notes

Identify areas that need particular review, migration/rollback considerations, and follow-up issues.
